abstract: Three-mode triage station for ambiguous requests (growme + change + improve). A router that turns vague intent into an executable spec, a task pile into a routed execution plan, and an existing plan into an improvement checklist. Native Chinese scenarios, cross-runtime neutral (Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode / OpenClaw / Hermes). Includes a 30+ skill routing table as a public asset — installing this skill is installing a 'full skill routing map'.
